name: @preflight/adapter-voiceos
description: Preflight × VoiceOS drop-in: a local stdio MCP server that wraps a downstream tool with the @preflight/core gate (the withPreflight pattern). OBSERVE (shadow) by default, ENFORCE opt-in. Emits a PreflightReceipt per call (the seam to Arav's post-verifier). Args-only degraded mode when the transcript seam is absent — labeled, never faked.
//build-choice: Same native-type-stripping build as @preflight/core: plain `node` runs the .ts files.
@preflight/core stays ZERO-dep; the MCP SDK is a dep of THIS package only (the adapter
is the layer allowed to depend on a wire protocol). The self-test wires a Client to the
Server over the SDK's in-memory linked transport pair — no stdio, no VoiceOS needed.
